description: Lifts a freeze and returns the account to active. ONLY a frozen account can be unfrozen: an account that is dormant or restricted is rejected, and this is not the route back from those states - report the state the account is actually in instead of calling this. A closed account can never be reopened. Set account_id to the id of the account - get it from list_accounts, never from the conversation alone. Safe to repeat: an account that is already active is returned unchanged and successfully. Requires the banking.account.freeze permission.
name: account_unfreeze_account
title: Unfreeze Account
